title: "The Rift First Appears"
next_chapter_hook: "That cold voice not only threatened Chen Ji, but also uttered a name that made Su Qingyao lose her composure on the spot."

text.content: "The moment the golden rift tore open above the imperial capital, Chen Ji felt as if his Tianji Record was being gripped by an invisible hand—not resonance, but a warning. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently trembled on the first page, at a frequency he had never felt before. 'Master, this is not something from the Three Realms.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor for the first time. 'It is an observer from a higher dimension.'"

dialogue.content: "(A cold smile curls at the corner of his lips, but his mind is rapidly calculating) Observers? Interesting. That bizarre sudden attack from foreign enemies in Chapter 442, I always thought it was the work of some hidden sect. So it turns out... they brought in reinforcements."

text.content: "The screams of the imperial capital's citizens pierced the sky. The aura leaking from that rift was to mortals like gazing directly at the scorching sun—blinding, burning, maddening. Some clutched their eyes and rolled on the ground, others collapsed with blood seeping from all seven orifices. Even cultivators felt their spiritual energy suppressed by some higher-dimensional rule."

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao arrived on her sword, her form swaying slightly as she landed. She stared intently at that golden rift, her face terrifyingly pale: 'Chen Ji, this aura... something deep in my bloodline is responding to it. Like... like someone is calling me.'"

"(Furrowing his brows slightly, the Tianji Record quietly flipping) Qingyao, step back for now. (Thinking to himself: Her bloodline can resonate with higher dimensions? It seems the Tianqing Sect's background runs deeper than I imagined.) You possess ancient bloodline, do you know that?"

text.content: "Just then, a cold voice echoed from within the rift. It was not any language, yet it resounded directly in every person present's divine consciousness—[The chess piece has jumped off the board. Executing clearance protocol.] The voice carried no emotional波动 whatsoever, as if all living beings in the Three Realms were merely erroneous data awaiting deletion in its eyes."

dialogue.content: "(A cold laugh, his voice not loud yet clearly entering the rift) Clearance protocol? What arrogance. You so-called observers, don't even follow the rules of chess? Just flip the board?"

text.content: "The voice within the rift paused, seemingly not expecting the chess piece to speak. A moment later, an even colder voice arose: [How可笑 is the arrogance of lower-dimensional civilizations. You think you are a chess master? You are merely a variable selected by the Tianji Record, a test case used to probe system vulnerabilities.]

choice.prompt: "Facing the threat from a higher-dimensional existence, Chen Ji must make a decision:"

choices.description: "Display strength, letting them know lower-dimensional civilizations are not lambs to be slaughtered. Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value to activate the Tianji Record's complete foresight ability."
choices.visible_reward: "Intimidate the higher-dimensional existence, earning the respect of the Three Realms' cultivators"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value consumption too great, future arrangements limited"

text.content: "Chen Ji hesitated no more, pouring all his Heavenly Fate Value into the Tianji Record. The golden pages burned炽热 in his palm, visions of the next three hours flooding into his divine consciousness like a torrent—he saw the core structure of that observation station within the rift, saw three nodes that could be used for counterattack."

choices.description: "Use the Tianji Record as a bargaining chip, engaging in博弈 with the higher-dimensional existence. Demonstrate the value of a chess master, trading for breathing room."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence, understanding the truth behind the clearance protocol"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may see through the disguise"

text.content: "Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record, a carefully calibrated expression of apprehension appearing on his face: 'Clearance protocol? Since you observers can monitor us, surely you know one thing—the Tianji Record is the only artifact that can foresee the future. Kill me, and you lose your best monitoring tool.'"

choices.description: "Do not engage the higher-dimensional existence in direct conflict, preserving trump cards while waiting for the right moment. Let the other party strike first to expose more information."
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Heavenly Fate Value, gaining strategic initiative"
choices.risk_hint: "May be seen as a coward by the Three Realms"

text.content: "Chen Ji coldly glanced at the rift, grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist: 'Let's go. If they're going to execute the protocol, they won't target just the imperial capital. We need more intelligence.' Su Qingyao tried to break free, but fell silent the moment she met his gaze—that gaze held something she had never seen before: ruthless calculation."

"No matter what choice was made, the existence within the rift gave different responses. And just then, Su Qingyao suddenly clutched her chest, her face deathly pale—for within that cold voice, a name had been夹杂, a name that made her lose composure on the spot. Chen Ji saw her reaction, his heart tightened, and the Tianji Record's visions once again vaguely浮现出 the source of that foreign enemy attack in Chapter 442..."

dialogue.content: "Impossible... This is impossible! Su Qingyao's voice trembled, the resonance deep in her bloodline transforming into tearing agony: 'That person they mentioned... died three hundred years ago! I watched them fall with my own eyes!'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, the Tianji Record flipping wildly, trying to capture information about the mentioned name. However, whenever the vision聚焦on that face, it became blurred—just like whenever he tried to foresee his sister Chen Nian. 'Mo Xiansheng.' he called in his heart, 'Does this person exist in your records?'"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long time, his voice艰涩: 'Master, some names have been deliberately erased. The Tianji Record is not omniscient... it too has forbidden territories it cannot touch. And the existences within those territories—' The remnant soul剧烈震颤on the pages, 'are probably even more dangerous than these observers.'"

text.content: "The golden light within the rift grew more intense, that cold voice sounding again, this time with a hint of mockery: [Su Qingyao, you think the thing in your bloodline awakened on its own? Three hundred years of布局, just for today's harvest. You think Chen Ji obtaining the Tianji Record was coincidental? Everything has been calculated.]

dialogue.content: "(His pupils slightly contracted, a cold smile in his heart) Layout and harvest? Interesting. Since you calculated everything, why didn't you calculate that I would reach this point today? (Turning to look at Su Qingyao) Qingyao, whatever they say, do you believe it?"

text.content: "Su Qingyao looked into Chen Ji's eyes, those eyes that always carried a lazy smile yet now were terrifyingly clear. She suddenly understood something, shaking her head vigorously, her voice hoarse yet firm: 'No. I don't believe a single word they say.'"

"The voice in the rift seemed to perceive this, the tone gaining a hint of playfulness: [Interesting. The observed reversely trusting the chess piece—how many times has this happened? However, it doesn't matter. Once the clearance protocol is initiated, there are no exceptions.] The words fell, the golden rift suddenly expanded, an eye condensed from pure dimensional power peering out from the crack, indifferently gazing upon the entire imperial capital."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji pulled Su Qingyao behind him, lifting his head to face that dimensional eye, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his lips: 'Exception? Let's see how you write this exception. (Quietly) The foreshadowing in Chapter 442, it's time to collect the net today.'"

text.content: "Just as that dimensional eye was about to lock onto Chen Ji, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with blinding light—Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested in the air for the first time, using an ancient yet authoritative voice to declare: 'Three-dimensional observation station, seventh branch, designation zero seven three two seven,违规initiating clearance protocol. Pursuant to Article Seven of the Ten Thousand Worlds Convention, we reserve the right to countermeasures.'"

"The dimensional eye剧烈收缩, that cold voice carrying surprise for the first time: [Ten Thousand Worlds Convention? A fragmented guardian remnant soul, what qualification do you—] Mo Xiansheng let out an ancient cold laugh: 'Qualification? I have none. But the Tianji Record does. Its previous master personally signed that convention.' The aura within the rift instantly凝固, and Chen Ji finally understood the true source of that foreign enemy attack in Chapter 442—that had merely been a试探 by the higher-dimensional civilization, and today, is the true settlement.
